title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per annum directly transferred via Aadhaar-linked DBT in 3 installments of Rs. 2,000 each.

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
description: Health insurance cover of Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization care to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless access to secondary and tertiary medical care up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empaneled hospitals.

eligibility.target_group: Low Income, BPL, Economically Vulnerable, Daily Wage Workers

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas to construct pucca houses.
benefits: Financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult districts, plus 90 days MGNREGA wage assistance.

eligibility.target_group: Rural Houseless, Kutcha House Residents, BPL

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides all-weather pucca houses to eligible urban families belonging to EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Groups.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 Lakh on home loans or direct central grant of Rs. 1.5 Lakh for house construction.

eligibility.target_group: Urban Poor, EWS, LIG, Private Sector Employees, Self Employed

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.
benefits: Skill training with Rs. 500/day stipend, Rs. 15,000 tool kit incentive, collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at concessional 5% interest rate.

eligibility.target_group: Traditional Artisans, Craftspeople, Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Masons, Tailors, Barbers

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit facility for urban street vendors to resume livelihoods with affordable working capital loans.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of Rs. 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs. 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.

eligibility.target_group: Street Vendors, Hawkers, Small Roadside Sellers, Urban Informal Workers

documents_required: Vending Certificate / Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body (ULB)

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children offering high compound interest and complete tax exemptions under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
benefits: 8.2%+ compound interest p.a., Section 80C tax deduction, tax-free maturity amount for girl's higher education and marriage.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card / Identity Proof of Guardian

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Direct cash maternity benefit to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health checkups and nutritional support.
benefits: Rs. 5,000 in two installments for the first living child; Rs. 6,000 for second child if girl child.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Mother and Husband

title: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed monthly pension for all unorganized sector workers upon reaching 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month for life after age 60.

eligibility.target_group: Unorganized Sector Workers, Non-Tax Payers, Self Employed

documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Legal guarantee for at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment at statutory state wage rates; unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.

eligibility.target_group: Rural Adult Citizens, Unskilled Workers, BPL

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu / Kishore / Tarun)
description: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs. 20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 50,000 (Shishu), Rs. 5 Lakh (Kishore), and up to Rs. 20 Lakh (Tarun) without collateral at competitive interest rates.

eligibility.target_group: Micro Entrepreneurs, Shopkeepers, Artisans, Small Business Owners, Women Entrepreneurs

documents_required: Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to SC, ST, OBC and EBC categories pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
benefits: Complete reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees plus monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs. 13,500/year.

eligibility.target_group: Students, SC, ST, OBC, EBC, Minority

documents_required: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Officer
Fee Receipt and College Admission Letter

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI
description: Adequate and timely credit support from the banking system for agricultural crop cultivation and animal husbandry.
benefits: Revolving credit limit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at an effective subsidized interest rate of 4% p.a. with prompt repayment incentive.

eligibility.target_group: Farmers, Cultivators, Dairy Farmers, Fishermen, Tenant Farmers

title: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (Senior Citizens 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Universal health insurance cover of Rs. 5 Lakh per year for ALL senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of income status.
benefits: Free cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per year specifically for individuals aged 70+.

eligibility.target_group: All Senior Citizens aged 70 and above

documents_required: Aadhaar Card (Aadhaar based e-KYC is mandatory)

title: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore at lowest applicable interest rates.
documents_required: Proof of Enterprise Address and Incorporation
